titles: How Big Was the Biggest Animal Ever? (Blue Whale vs Megalodon vs Dinosaurs)
Megalodon, Dinosaurs or the Blue Whale: Who Was Really the Biggest?
The Biggest Animal Ever Is Alive Right Now
hook: Is the blue whale really the biggest animal that has ever lived? We measure it against megalodon, the giant dinosaurs Argentinosaurus and Patagotitan, the fossil whale Perucetus and the sea reptile Ichthyotitan, side by side on a metre grid next to a person and a bus, with every number in metres AND feet and every estimate sourced. Spoiler: the length race is close. The weight race is not.
